newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close down on continuing selling.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close down on continuing selling.

text.p: Dhaka shares tumbled nearly three percent after mounting selling strained prices across the board in a low-volume session, brokers said.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all share price index shed 73.10 points or 2.82 percent, at 2,514.14. Tunrover fell to 38.2 million taka from Thursday's 77 million. Of 88 traded issues, 80 lost, seven gained and one ended flat.
"The downtrend may continue until banks begin the new year in January and become liberal with loans," one broker said.
Beximco Pharma lost 14.42 taka to 274 and Singer Bangladesh shed 781.60 to 14,860.
